\newcommand{\ottdruleSAXXTransXXTVar}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ \mathit{X}   <:   \ottnt{U}  \in  \Gamma }%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{U}  <:  \ottnt{T}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \mathit{X}  <:  \ottnt{T}}{%
{\ottdrulename{SA\_Trans\_TVar}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleSAXXArrow}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  <:  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  <:  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \rightarrow  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  <:  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \rightarrow  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{SA\_Arrow}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleSAXXAll}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  <:  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \ottsym{,}  \mathit{X}  <:  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  <:  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash   \forall   \mathit{X}  \mathord{ <: }  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}} . \,  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{2}}}}   <:   \forall   \mathit{X}  \mathord{ <: }  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}} . \,  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}} }{%
{\ottdrulename{SA\_All}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleSAXXRcd}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ \forall  \ottmv{i}  \in 1 ..  \ottmv{m}  .  \Gamma  \vdash  \mathit{k_{\ottmv{i}}} \, \ottnt{S_{\ottmv{i}}}  \ottsym{<:f}  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}} }%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{k_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{k_{\ottmv{m}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S_{\ottmv{m}}}  \ottsym{\}}  <:  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{SA\_Rcd}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnSA}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{S}  <:  \ottnt{T}$}{\ottcom{$\ottnt{S}$ is a subtype of $\ottnt{T}$}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleSAXXTop{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleSAXXReflXXTVar{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleSAXXTransXXTVar{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleSAXXArrow{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleSAXXAll{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleSAXXRcd{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn SAf
\newcommand{\ottdruleSAfXXfound}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{S}  <:  \ottnt{T}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \mathit{k} \, \ottnt{S}  \ottsym{<:f}  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{k}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}  \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{SAf\_found}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleSAfXXskip}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \mathit{k} \, \ottnt{S}  \ottsym{<:f}  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \mathit{k} \, \ottnt{S}  \ottsym{<:f}  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}  \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{SAf\_skip}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnSAf}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\Gamma  \vdash  \mathit{k} \, \ottnt{S}  \ottsym{<:f}  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}$}{\ottcom{field $\mathit{k}$:$\ottnt{S}$ is matched, with subtyping, by a field of the record}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleSAfXXfound{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleSAfXXskip{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn Ty
\newcommand{\ottdruleTyChXXVar}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash \, \ottkw{ok}}%
\ottpremise{ \mathit{x}   \ottsym{:}   \ottnt{T}  \in  \Gamma }%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \mathit{x}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}}{%
{\ottdrulename{TyCh\_Var}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTyChXXAbs}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \ottsym{,}  \mathit{x}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash   \lambda  \mathit{x}  \mathord{ \ottsym{:} }  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}} . \,  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}   \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \rightarrow  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{TyCh\_Abs}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTyChXXApp}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{11}}}}  \rightarrow  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{12}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{11}}}}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{12}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{TyCh\_App}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTyChXXTAbs}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \ottsym{,}  \mathit{X}  <:  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash   \Lambda  \mathit{X}  \mathord{ <: }  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}} . \,  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}   \ottsym{:}   \forall   \mathit{X}  \mathord{ <: }  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}} . \,  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}} }{%
{\ottdrulename{TyCh\_TAbs}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTyChXXTApp}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}   \forall   \mathit{X}  \mathord{ <: }  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{11}}}} . \,  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{12}}}} }%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  <:  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{11}}}}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{[}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{]}  \ottsym{:}  \ottsym{[}  \mathit{X}  \mapsto  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{]}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{12}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{TyCh\_TApp}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTyChXXLet}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
\ottpremise{\vdash  \ottnt{p}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \Rightarrow  \Delta}%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \ottsym{,}  \Delta  \vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottkw{let} \, \ottnt{p}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottkw{in} \, \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{TyCh\_Let}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTyChXXRcd}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \quad .. \quad \Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{t_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{\ottmv{n}}}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{n}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{t_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{TyCh\_Rcd}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTyChXXProj}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{:}  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{.}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{j}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{\ottmv{j}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{TyCh\_Proj}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleTyChXXSub}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{S}}%
\ottpremise{\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{S}  <:  \ottnt{T}}%
}{
\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}}{%
{\ottdrulename{TyCh\_Sub}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnTy}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\Gamma  \vdash  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}$}{\ottcom{term $\ottnt{t}$ has type $\ottnt{T}$}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleTyChXXVar{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleTyChXXAbs{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleTyChXXApp{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleTyChXXTAbs{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleTyChXXTApp{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleTyChXXLet{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleTyChXXRcd{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleTyChXXProj{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleTyChXXSub{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn Pat
\newcommand{\ottdrulePatXXVar}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\vdash  \mathit{x}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}  \Rightarrow  \ottkw{empty}  \ottsym{,}  \mathit{x}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}}{%
{\ottdrulename{Pat\_Var}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulePatXXRcd}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\vdash  \ottnt{p_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \Rightarrow  \Delta_{{\mathrm{1}}} \quad .. \quad \vdash  \ottnt{p_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{\ottmv{n}}}  \Rightarrow  \Delta_{\ottmv{n}}}%
}{
\vdash  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{p_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{n}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{p_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}  \Rightarrow  \Delta_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \Delta_{\ottmv{n}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{Pat\_Rcd}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnPat}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\vdash  \ottnt{p}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}  \Rightarrow  \Delta$}{\ottcom{pattern $\ottnt{p}$ matches type $\ottnt{T}$ giving bindings $\Delta$}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulePatXXVar{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulePatXXRcd{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}


\newcommand{\ottdefnsJtype}{
\ottdefnGok{}\ottdefnGT{}\ottdefnSA{}\ottdefnSAf{}\ottdefnTy{}\ottdefnPat{}}

% defns Jop
%% defn reduce
\newcommand{\ottdrulereduceXXAppAbs}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\ottsym{(}   \lambda  \mathit{x}  \mathord{ \ottsym{:} }  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{11}}}} . \,  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{12}}}}   \ottsym{)} \, \ottnt{v_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \longrightarrow  \ottsym{[}  \mathit{x}  \mapsto  \ottnt{v_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{]}  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{12}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{reduce\_AppAbs}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulereduceXXTappTabs}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\ottsym{(}   \Lambda  \mathit{X}  \mathord{ <: }  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{11}}}} . \,  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{12}}}}   \ottsym{)}  \ottsym{[}  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{]}  \longrightarrow  \ottsym{[}  \mathit{X}  \mapsto  \ottnt{T_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \ottsym{]}  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{12}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{reduce\_TappTabs}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulereduceXXLetV}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottkw{match} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{p}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{v_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{)}  \!\! = \!\!  \sigma}%
}{
\ottkw{let} \, \ottnt{p}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottkw{in} \, \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \longrightarrow  \sigma \, \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{reduce\_LetV}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulereduceXXProjRcd}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l'_{\ottmv{n}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}  \ottsym{.}  \mathit{l'_{\ottmv{j}}}  \longrightarrow  \ottnt{v_{\ottmv{j}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{reduce\_ProjRcd}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulereduceXXCtxXXappXXfun}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \longrightarrow  \ottnt{t'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
}{
\ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottnt{t}  \longrightarrow  \ottnt{t'_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottnt{t}}{%
{\ottdrulename{reduce\_Ctx\_app\_fun}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulereduceXXCtxXXappXXarg}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \longrightarrow  \ottnt{t'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
}{
\ottnt{v} \, \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \longrightarrow  \ottnt{v} \, \ottnt{t'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{reduce\_Ctx\_app\_arg}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulereduceXXCtxXXtypeXXfun}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \longrightarrow  \ottnt{t'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
}{
\ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{[}  \ottnt{T}  \ottsym{]}  \longrightarrow  \ottnt{t'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{[}  \ottnt{T}  \ottsym{]}}{%
{\ottdrulename{reduce\_Ctx\_type\_fun}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulereduceXXCtxXXrecord}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{t}  \longrightarrow  \ottnt{t'}}%
}{
\ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{m}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{\ottmv{m}}}  \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{t}  \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{t'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l'_{\ottmv{n}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{t'_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}  \longrightarrow  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{m}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{\ottmv{m}}}  \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{t'}  \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{t'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l'_{\ottmv{n}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{t'_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{reduce\_Ctx\_record}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdrulereduceXXCtxXXletXXbinding}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \longrightarrow  \ottnt{t'_{{\mathrm{1}}}}}%
}{
\ottkw{let} \, \ottnt{p}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottkw{in} \, \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}  \longrightarrow  \ottkw{let} \, \ottnt{p}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{t'_{{\mathrm{1}}}} \, \ottkw{in} \, \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{reduce\_Ctx\_let\_binding}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnreduce}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \longrightarrow  \ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}$}{\ottcom{$\ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{1}}}}$ reduces to $\ottnt{t_{{\mathrm{2}}}}$}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulereduceXXAppAbs{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulereduceXXTappTabs{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulereduceXXLetV{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulereduceXXProjRcd{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulereduceXXCtxXXappXXfun{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulereduceXXCtxXXappXXarg{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulereduceXXCtxXXtypeXXfun{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulereduceXXCtxXXrecord{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdrulereduceXXCtxXXletXXbinding{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn M
\newcommand{\ottdruleMXXVar}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
}{
\ottkw{match} \, \ottsym{(}  \mathit{x}  \ottsym{:}  \ottnt{T}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{v}  \ottsym{)}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottsym{[}  \mathit{x}  \mapsto  \ottnt{v}  \ottsym{]}}{%
{\ottdrulename{M\_Var}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleMXXRcd}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{ \forall  \ottmv{i}  \in 1 ..  \ottmv{m}  .  \ottkw{matchfield} \, \ottsym{(}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{i}}}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{p_{\ottmv{i}}}  \ottsym{)} \, \ottkw{vs} \, \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{k_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{k_{\ottmv{n}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}} \, \ottkw{gives} \, \sigma_{\ottmv{i}} }%
}{
\ottkw{match} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{p_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{l_{\ottmv{m}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{p_{\ottmv{m}}}  \ottsym{\}}  \ottsym{,}  \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{k_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{k_{\ottmv{n}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}}  \ottsym{)}  \!\! = \!\!  \sigma_{{\mathrm{1}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \sigma_{\ottmv{m}}}{%
{\ottdrulename{M\_Rcd}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnM}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottkw{match} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{p}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{v}  \ottsym{)}  \!\! = \!\!  \sigma$}{}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleMXXVar{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleMXXRcd{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}

%% defn Mf
\newcommand{\ottdruleMfXXfound}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottkw{match} \, \ottsym{(}  \ottnt{p}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{v}  \ottsym{)}  \!\! = \!\!  \sigma}%
}{
\ottkw{matchfield} \, \ottsym{(}  \mathit{l}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{p}  \ottsym{)} \, \ottkw{vs} \, \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{l}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v}  \ottsym{,}  \mathit{k_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{k_{\ottmv{n}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}} \, \ottkw{gives} \, \sigma}{%
{\ottdrulename{Mf\_found}}{}%
}}


\newcommand{\ottdruleMfXXskip}[1]{\ottdrule[#1]{%
\ottpremise{\ottkw{matchfield} \, \ottsym{(}  \mathit{l}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{p}  \ottsym{)} \, \ottkw{vs} \, \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{k_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{k_{\ottmv{n}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}} \, \ottkw{gives} \, \sigma}%
}{
\ottkw{matchfield} \, \ottsym{(}  \mathit{l}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{p}  \ottsym{)} \, \ottkw{vs} \, \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{k}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v}  \ottsym{,}  \mathit{k_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{k_{\ottmv{n}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}} \, \ottkw{gives} \, \sigma}{%
{\ottdrulename{Mf\_skip}}{}%
}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnMf}[1]{\begin{ottdefnblock}[#1]{$\ottkw{matchfield} \, \ottsym{(}  \mathit{l}  \ottsym{,}  \ottnt{p}  \ottsym{)} \, \ottkw{vs} \, \ottsym{\{}  \mathit{k_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{{\mathrm{1}}}}  \ottsym{,} \, .. \, \ottsym{,}  \mathit{k_{\ottmv{n}}}  \!\! = \!\!  \ottnt{v_{\ottmv{n}}}  \ottsym{\}} \, \ottkw{gives} \, \sigma$}{}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleMfXXfound{}}
\ottusedrule{\ottdruleMfXXskip{}}
\end{ottdefnblock}}


\newcommand{\ottdefnsJop}{
\ottdefnreduce{}\ottdefnM{}\ottdefnMf{}}

\newcommand{\ottdefnss}{
\ottdefnsJudgementXXin
\ottdefnsJtype
